title: From Facts to Insights: A Persona-Driven Dual Memory Framework and Dataset for Role-Playing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.25693v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While role-playing agents excel in short-term interactions, long-term conversations overwhelm context windows, motivating external memory frameworks. Current systems typically rely on persona-agnostic summarization, which records facts without persona-specific interpretation, yielding generic responses that compromise persona fidelity. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoleMemo, a dataset featuring four reasoning tasks where the factual fragments must be interpreted through the persona to reach the correct answer. Evaluation on RoleMemo exposes critical limitations of persona-agnostic frameworks. We thus propose DualMem, which decouples memory into two streams: factual cognition and persona-conditioned insight. Trained through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), our framework with a 4B-parameter model outperforms zero-shot persona-agnostic frameworks powered by DeepSeek-V3.2 for sustained persona fidelity. Ou

translated_title: 从事实到洞察：面向角色扮演代理的基于人格的双记忆框架与数据集
translated_abstract: 尽管角色扮演代理在短期交互中表现出色，但长期对话会使上下文窗口不堪重负，这促使了外部记忆框架的发展。当前系统通常依赖于与人格无关的摘要方法，这种方法仅记录事实而不进行人格特定的解读，导致产生泛化的回复，损害了人格忠实度。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了RoleMemo数据集，该数据集包含四个推理任务，其中事实片段必须通过人格视角进行解读才能得出正确答案。在RoleMemo上的评估揭示了与人格无关的框架的关键局限性。因此，我们提出了DualMem，它将记忆解耦为两条流：事实认知与基于人格的洞察。通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行训练，我们的框架仅使用40亿参数的模型，就在持续人格忠实度方面超越了由DeepSeek-V3.2驱动的零样本与人格无关框架。
tldr: 提出了DualMem双记忆框架，将记忆解耦为事实认知与人格洞察两条流，并配合RoleMemo数据集，使仅40亿参数的模型在长期角色扮演中的人格忠实度超越了基于DeepSeek-V3.2的零样本框架。
en_tdlr: We propose DualMem, a dual memory framework that decouples memory into factual cognition and persona-conditioned insight streams, along with the RoleMemo dataset, enabling a 4B-parameter model to outperform zero-shot persona-agnostic frameworks powered by DeepSeek-V3.2 in sustaining persona fidelity for long-term role-playing conversations.
